"text": "Security concern type: unauthorized access\nAffected account or platform: Velvet Acorn Custody login\nDate client reported concern: [relative or entered date]\nClient's preferred contact method: secure portal / phone\nImmediate action requested: reset credentials\nCustodian or platform contact: [contact name or department]\nEvidence to review: login alert forwarded by Paige Lanternmoss\nResolution status: open\nNext client update: phone call\nInternal notes: [brief notes only; do not include passwords, full account numbers, or sensitive credentials]\nEscalate the issue with Velvet Acorn Custody, document the login alert evidence, coordinate credential reset, and provide a phone update to Paige Lanternmoss by the due date.",

Confirm receipt of the completed signature page and update the document status log.\nThe household authorization package is missing Darin’s signature page; contact him, explain the required signature location, and confirm secure return.",

"text": "Check the pending transfer with the receiving custodian, note the latest status, and alert the advisor if assets, cost basis, or residual cash have not arrived as expected.\nThe Velvet Acorn Custody transfer shows securities received but the cost basis file and residual cash sweep do not match the sending statement; verify the latest status and document any pending items.",

"title": "Complete beneficiary update workflow",
"text": "Use this workflow when a client needs to add, remove, or revise beneficiary designations. Confirm the requested change, gather the required custodian forms or online instructions, submit the update, and verify the custodian's final confirmation before closing the loop with the client.\nPaige requested changes to IRA beneficiary records for Darin, Liora, and the Willow Pudding Family Trust, including revised primary and contingent percentages.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-11-14",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Confirm beneficiary instructions",
"text": "Review the client's requested beneficiary changes, including primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, relationship details, and any per stirpes or trust-related language. Flag anything that requires attorney or estate planning review.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "08744d31-7555-51ee-a1eb-a482b9defeeb"
},
{
"title": "Prepare custodian documentation",
"text": "Identify the correct beneficiary update method for each affected account, prepare forms or portal steps, and confirm whether spousal consent, medallion signature guarantee, or trust documentation is required.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "ddfe45a4-1a81-5a26-8db5-0d7287fbbec9"
},
{
"title": "Submit and track update",
"text": "Submit the completed documentation through the approved custodian channel and track the request until the custodian confirms the beneficiary record has been updated.",

"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "ddfe45a4-1a81-5a26-8db5-0d7287fbbec9"
},
{
"title": "Confirm completion with client",
"text": "Send the client a concise confirmation that the beneficiary update has been completed, noting any accounts still pending or any items the client should retain with estate documents.",

],

},
{
"templateId": "ff5229e6-e93f-5a25-852e-f97d59d919cf",
"title": "Review insurance policy details",
"text": "Complete the following checks:\n- Confirm policy type, owner, insured, beneficiary, and premium payer.\n- Review current death benefit, cash value, surrender value, riders, and premium schedule if applicable.\n- Check whether beneficiary designations align with the client's estate and family goals.\n- Identify pending premium increases, lapse risk, term expiration, conversion options, or long-term care benefit triggers.\n- Request the most recent in-force illustration or policy statement when needed.\n- Note any tax, estate, liquidity, or coverage gaps to discuss with the advisor.\n- Document whether outside insurance, legal, or tax professionals should be consulted.\nCurrent premium schedule, conversion language, and recent policy statements for Paige’s $1 million Silver Marmot Life term policy are needed to assess coverage timing, premium changes, and beneficiary alignment.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Current policy evidence is needed before Apricot Compass can assess coverage timing, premium changes, and beneficiary alignment; no due date was supplied."
},
{
"templateId": "b91c5012-f119-507f-91de-d78d8599cb42",
"title": "Review charitable transfer readiness",
"text": "Review the proposed charitable transfer using these criteria and collect supporting evidence:\n- Confirm intended recipient is a qualified charity or eligible donor-advised fund sponsor.\n- Confirm asset type, estimated value, cost basis if available, holding period, and whether appreciated securities are involved.\n- Confirm source account registration and authority to give transfer instructions.\n- Verify delivery instructions, including recipient name, tax identification details if provided securely, custodian delivery method, and any special purpose or designation language.\n- Check whether the gift should be coordinated with the client's tax advisor for deductibility, AGI limits, bunching strategy, or required minimum distribution treatment.\n- Confirm whether the client needs an acknowledgment letter, gift receipt, or confirmation for tax records.\n- Evidence to collect: client authorization, current position or cash balance, charity delivery instructions, custodian form or portal confirmation, and final transfer confirmation.\nPaige is considering a gift of appreciated Copper Firefly Systems shares to Marzipan Meadow Arts Fund; gather asset details, charity delivery instructions, and tax coordination questions.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-11-21",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-21 covering the proposed asset, charity delivery instructions, tax coordination questions, and confirmation evidence needed for Paige’s records."
},
{
